findings.message: OpenAI chat.completions.create() response is never inspected for .usage. Without reading response.usage (total_tokens, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens), you have no visibility into token consumption or API cost. Log or record usage data: `log_tokens(response.usage.total_tokens)` or push to your cost tracking system. Alternatively, instrument with a proxy like Helicone, Langfuse, or LiteLLM to capture usage automatically.
SDK generation call missing max_tokens, max_output_tokens, or max_completion_tokens.

OpenAI API call without `seed` parameter. Without a fixed seed, prompt caching is unreliable and outputs are non-deterministic across identical inputs. Add `seed=42` (or any fixed integer) to enable deterministic caching and reduce redundant API costs.

Hardcoded model="gpt-4" (legacy). gpt-4 costs ~$30/M tokens vs gpt-4o-mini at $0.15/M (200x cheaper). Unless you specifically need legacy gpt-4 behaviour, migrate to gpt-4o-mini for most tasks, or gpt-4o for those requiring stronger capability. Route via env var: model=os.getenv("LLM_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini").

Deprecated model name hardcoded in API call. These models have been superseded and OpenAI/Anthropic may silently route them to more expensive successor models. Replace with a current model via environment variable (e.g. os.environ['LLM_MODEL']) to avoid unexpected cost increases. Deprecated: gpt-4 → gpt-4o, gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct → gpt-4o-mini, claude-2 → claude-3-haiku, claude-instant-* → claude-3-haiku, text-davinci-003 → gpt-4o-mini.

Expensive frontier model hardcoded as string literal with no env-var routing. Every call uses the same model regardless of task complexity. Use os.getenv('LLM_MODEL', 'gpt-4o-mini') or a model router to reduce costs on simpler tasks.

Streaming LLM call without a token budget (max_tokens / max_completion_tokens). Without a cap, a streaming response can run until the model's context limit is exhausted — generating tens of thousands of tokens undetected. Add max_tokens=N to bound the output cost.

OpenAI client instantiated without a timeout. Without a timeout, API requests can hang indefinitely — the model runs (and you are billed) while your process blocks. Set timeout=30.0 (seconds) or use httpx.Timeout for fine-grained control. In agent loops, a single hung request can block all downstream tasks.

Audio transcription submitted without voice-activity detection (VAD) or silence pruning. Silence and noise in audio clips are still billed by duration (Whisper: $0.006/min). Pre-process audio with pydub or WebRTC VAD to strip silence before submission, or use faster-whisper with vad_filter=True.
